caption: Supplementary Fig. 31 | Pre-event environments and subsequent moisture changes in the South China Sea. a, Return-minus-complete-nonreturn contrasts in pre-event means at −24, −18, −12 and −6 h, requiring three valid times and divided by fixed global reference SDs. Each variable uses 15 returns and 30 nonreturns, except PI − V (two/four cyclones; point estimate only). b, Observed 700-hPa humidity, 1991–2020 month-and-UTC background and anomaly contrasts on identical native cells and SID–lag support (15/30 cyclones). c,d, Integrated 0–24 h budget contrasts for 100–300 and 300–800 km, respectively. Horizontal advection, vertical advection and residual sum to the moving tendency; net is the total. e, Fixed-frame tendency plus storm-motion contribution equals moving tendency. All six diagnostics share native support and five six-hour observations within each radius (inner 15/30; outer 15/29); fixed-frame horizontal advection is retained in the source data. f, Integrated 850-hPa moisture-flux convergence on its own pressure-level support. Whiskers are 95% intervals from 2,000 SID resamples; Table S12f gives all budget intervals and counts. Inner and outer populations differ, so these are separate outcome-group comparisons rather than paired radial contrasts. Unknown outcomes remain separate in the source data.
